inicio.titulo: A taste of home, right here in Montreal
inicio.lead: Freshly baked Mexican sweet bread, handmade paletas and everything you miss from Mexico: groceries, drinks and snacks.
inicio.especialidadesTexto: The best of Mexico, with a homey touch.
inicio.panTexto: Conchas, cookies, bolillos, pan de muerto and more Mexican sweet bread, fresh every day.
inicio.paletasTexto: Handmade fruit, chamoy and cream paletas, plus ice cream.
inicio.abarrotesTexto: Chiles, salsas, tortillas, candy, Mexican sodas and snacks for every craving.
inicio.razon1: Artisan bread and paletas, just like back home.
inicio.razon2: The Mexican products and brands you miss.
inicio.razon3: A little corner of Mexico in Montreal where you're always welcome.
inicio.razon4: Order by phone and we'll bring it to you.
pedido.texto: For now, delivery orders are by phone only.
pan.lead: Mexican sweet and savoury bread, fresh every day.
pan.nota: Availability changes daily. Call us to reserve your bread or place a large order.
paletas.lead: Artisan fruit, chamoy and cream paletas, and ice cream for every taste.
paletas.nota: Flavours may change with the season. Having a party? Call us about large orders.
abarrotes.lead: Mexican products for your pantry, snacks, drinks and household items.
abarrotes.antojitos1: Snack cakes like Gansito and Pingüinos
abarrotes.nota: Looking for something specific? Call us and we'll tell you if we have it.
contacto.lead: Visit us at the store or order delivery by phone.
contacto.paso1: Call us at the number below.
contacto.paso2: Tell us what you'd like and your address.
contacto.paso3: We'll confirm the total and delivery time.
contacto.soloLlamada: For now, orders are by phone only.
pie.texto: Mexican corner store in Montreal: bread, paletas, groceries and snacks.
temporada.texto: Soft and fragrant, with sesame seeds, glazed or with a concha topping. Seasonal only: come get yours or call us to reserve it.

meta.descInicio: Casa Chelito, a Mexican corner store in Montreal: sweet bread, artisan paletas, ice cream, groceries, drinks and snacks. Delivery orders by phone.
meta.descPan: Mexican bread in Montreal: conchas, cookies, bolillos and seasonal pan de muerto at Casa Chelito.
meta.descPaletas: Artisan paletas and ice cream in Montreal: fruit, chamoy and cream paletas, scooped ice cream and soft serve.
meta.descAbarrotes: Mexican groceries in Montreal: salsas, chiles, moles, candy, snack cakes, sodas and cleaning products.
meta.descContacto: Visit Casa Chelito in Montreal or order delivery by phone. Hours, address and how to place your order.
